baseline_models.focus_anchor: The doubled ن س ي construction links نَسُوا اللَّهَ causally to فَأَنسَاهُمْ أَنفُسَهُمْ, then names the result الفاسقون.
baseline_models.mechanism: The first forgetting can be active neglect as well as loss of recollection; the causative second turn makes that abandoned relation rebound upon the agents' own identities. The final ف س ق image adds an exit from a containing rind: neglected worship becomes inward dispossession and then visible boundary-breach.

activation_trace.role: Neglect and abandonment distinguish the initiating act from mere accidental lapse and supply the causal first movement.
Loss of held remembrance supplies the inward effect and lets the repeated root operate as a mirrored reversal.
The worshipped one is the abandoned orienting relation rather than one forgotten datum among others.
The self as the thing's own identity and reality makes the returned loss ontological, not merely mnemonic.
A ripe fruit leaving its rind gives the outcome a concrete shape of exiting a sustaining boundary.

changed_reading.before: They forgot God, were made unaware of themselves, and are therefore sinners.
changed_reading.after: Their active abandonment of the worship relation rebounds as loss of their own identity, until the inward loss appears as an exit from the boundary that had held them.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: أَنفُسَهُمْ can name what is within the self, while the repeated forgetting removes access to it.
baseline_models.mechanism: The self includes inward reason, intention, and discrimination. On that branch, being made to forget oneself means losing the inner faculty by which purposes and consequences are recognized; فسق is the outward departure generated by that inward failure of orientation.

activation_trace.role: The disappearance of something once held in awareness supplies the loss of inward access.
The self's reason, intention, and inward awareness identify what becomes unavailable.
The rind-exit renders failed inward discrimination as an eventual outward departure.

changed_reading.before: Forgetting oneself means no longer attending to one's welfare.
changed_reading.after: Forgetting oneself includes losing the inner reason and intention that could recognize one's welfare, so external transgression grows from an evacuated center.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah's repeated universal glorification places human remembrance inside a creation-wide act of worship. Against that envelope, forgetting God is not private inattention alone; it is nonparticipation in the surrounding order, and the focus's rind-exit becomes departure from that shared orientation.

activation_trace.role: Worship is the relation whose remembrance connects the human agent to the wider frame.
Exit from a rind gives material form to departure from the encompassing order.
Glorification as worship opens the context with all creation already engaged in divine remembrance.
The same worshipful glorification closes the context and completes the envelope around the warning.

structural_cues: 59:1 and 59:24 repeat the heavens-and-earth glorification frame around the intervening human failures.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies universal tasbih at both boundaries and the focus's forgetting/exit sequence; I infer that active remembrance is human participation in that order. A live alternative is that the tasbih refrain frames divine sovereignty without directly explaining the psychology of 59:19.

changed_reading.before: The verse warns an individual not to neglect God.
changed_reading.after: The warning concerns withdrawing from a creation-wide practice of divine orientation, a withdrawal that leaves the person outside both the common order and their own coherent self.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier defeat moves from confidence in an enclosing fortress, to fear lodged in the core, to inhabitants ruining their own dwellings with hands. This supplies an enacted mechanism for أَنسَاهُمْ أَنفُسَهُمْ: false external preservation accompanies inward evacuation, after which the agents become instruments of their own unhousing.

activation_trace.role: Abandonment supplies the inward evacuation that the earlier material sequence enacts.
The self as one's own identity is the inward habitation lost before the outer house falls.
The fruit's exit from its covering links inward evacuation to breached containment.
Preservation inside an enclosing fortress supplies the external shell falsely trusted to secure the occupants.
The heart as the pure core locates the decisive breach inside rather than at the wall.
Ruination of built habitation turns inner defeat into dismantled form.
Dwelling and shelter provide the material analogue for a self no longer inhabited or protected.
What the hands themselves bring about makes the collapse partly self-authored rather than merely imposed from outside.

structural_cues: 59:2 orders presumed protection, an uncalculated arrival, fear cast into hearts, and houses ruined by their occupants' own hands.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fortress, core, ruin, shelter, and acting hands; I infer the direction from inward loss to self-demolition and map the house onto the self. The live alternative is that 59:2 remains only a historical instance of judgment rather than a mechanism for 59:19.

changed_reading.before: God causes the neglectful to lose awareness of their interests.
changed_reading.after: God's causing them to forget themselves appears as interior eviction: the core fails first, external security becomes useless, and their own agency dismantles the shelter it meant to preserve.

context_deltas.mechanism: The palm scene places cutting apart beside remaining upright on roots and then names the fasiqin; the focus repeats that label and supplies its fruit-leaving-rind image. As a material activation, remembrance becomes rooted standing, while self-forgetting culminates in detachment from what lets a self stand.

activation_trace.role: Coming to be and being present make the warning concern a sustained mode of existence.
Abandonment provides the relational severance translated into the tree image.
A fruit leaving its rind anchors the focus in organic detachment.
Severing and separating supply one side of the material contrast.
Bodily uprightness supplies the posture of the palm that remains standing.
Root and base identify what supports continued standing.
The shared fasiq label carries the organic rind-exit image from the palm context into the focus.

structural_cues: 59:5 juxtaposes cutting a palm with leaving it standing upon its roots immediately before its fasiqin closure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies severance, upright standing, roots, and the repeated fasiq label; I supply the analogy between botanical support and remembered divine relation. A materially live alternative is that the palm operations are only two permitted tactics and do not symbolize the two human conditions.

changed_reading.before: Do not become people who have crossed a moral rule.
changed_reading.after: Do not become selves detached from their sustaining root: the verse's moral exit can be pictured as organic unhousing rather than rule-breaking alone.

context_deltas.mechanism: The hosts place others before their own selves despite privation, are protected from the self's withholding greed, and thereby attain enduring success. This reverses an egoistic account of self-care: the self is not preserved by clutching it, but recovered through God-oriented preference beyond its possessive impulse.

activation_trace.role: Neglect becomes a failure of right relation rather than a purely private memory defect.
The self as identity is what the apparently self-protective impulse actually loses.
Choosing another over oneself supplies the counter-practice through which selfhood is paradoxically preserved.
The repeated self-identity links preference over selves to the possessive pressure within a self.
Withholding joined to eager possession names the inner force that mistakes hoarding for self-preservation.
Success as victory and enduring survival marks the outcome of overcoming possessive selfhood.

structural_cues: 59:9 moves from love of migrants, through preference over one's own selves despite need, to protection from the self's greed and success.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies self-preference, inner withholding, protection, and success; I infer that these form the positive inverse of self-forgetting. The alternative is a looser ethical contrast in which generosity exemplifies faith without defining how the self is forgotten.

changed_reading.before: Forgetting the self is an inward failure to look after oneself.
changed_reading.after: Forgetting the self can be socially diagnosed: possessive fixation impersonates self-care but loses the true self, whereas preferring others under divine orientation preserves it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The hypocritical alliance has a displayed entrance and concealed exit: its promises are false, its members look gathered while their cores are scattered, and its instigator finally disowns the follower. The focus's forgotten self can therefore be a borrowed group identity with no stable inward owner, exposed as soon as pressure arrives.

activation_trace.role: Abandonment becomes both the initiating neglect and the eventual abandonment by the identity one borrowed.
Self as one's own identity anchors the model in the focus rather than in group betrayal alone.
A displayed entrance with a hidden exit gives the professed alliance a structurally divided identity.
Contradiction of truth marks the spoken collective identity as a performance rather than a dependable bond.
Joining dispersed parts supplies the visible appearance of one body.
The core of each member is where the apparent unity fails.
Dispersal and scattering expose the plurality hidden beneath the gathered surface.
Disavowal and distancing complete the collapse of the borrowed identity.

structural_cues: 59:11-16 progresses from promises of shared exit and aid, through nonperformance and internally scattered unity, to the instigator's explicit disavowal.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies concealed exit, false speech, gathered appearance, scattered cores, and disavowal; I infer that dependence on this alliance displaces one's own moral agency. The alternative is that the sequence diagnoses unreliable coalitions without making a claim about personal identity.

changed_reading.before: Those who forget God separately become inattentive to themselves.
changed_reading.after: They may lose themselves by inhabiting a performed collective identity: its words replace their agency, its hidden exits divide them, and its final disavowal leaves no coherent self or community behind.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding command makes a self inspect what it has sent ahead for tomorrow, then names God's knowledge of action. The focus's self-forgetting is thus a break in diachronic identity: the present actor no longer recognizes the future self that will receive what today's action advances.

activation_trace.role: Loss of held awareness names the break between present action and remembered future consequence.
Self as continuing identity anchors the temporal continuity that is broken.
The self's inward reason and intention are commissioned to conduct the examination.
Directed sight or insight supplies deliberate self-examination rather than passive recollection.
Advancing something forward makes present action a delivery to a later state.
The following day supplies the future horizon toward which the self must remain continuous.
Intentional action identifies the concrete material carried from present self to future self.

structural_cues: 59:18 immediately precedes the focus, repeats ن ف س, and contrasts looking at what was advanced for tomorrow with the next verse's forgetting of selves.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies self-inspection, advancing, tomorrow, action, and then self-forgetting; I infer a present-to-future continuity and treat its collapse as the causal content of forgetting. The alternative is a simpler contrast between accountability and heedlessness without a diachronic model of selfhood.

changed_reading.before: They fail to remember who they are now.
changed_reading.after: They sever today's acting self from tomorrow's receiving self, so the inability to account for what is being sent forward is itself the forgetting of their selves.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing names God as knower of hidden and witnessed, then as measurer-creator, originator, and giver of form and names. The self in 59:19 is therefore not self-grounding: forgetting its divine source of knowledge, measure, existence, form, and designation removes the coordinates by which it can know itself.

activation_trace.role: The worship relation anchors the self in the one later named as its knower and maker.
Self as identity, reality, and essence is the dependent object whose coordinates are lost.
Disclosure to the knower establishes divine knowledge as spanning what the self may not disclose to itself.
What is hidden from eyes supplies the concealed dimension of self and consequence still known to God.
Presence with witnessing supplies the manifest dimension paired with the hidden.
Measuring and proportioning supply the self's given scale rather than a self-invented one.
Creation and origination supply the self's dependence for existence.
Form and fashioned configuration supply the self's determinate shape.
Naming as designation, active especially in the names occurrence, supplies the coordinate by which identity is indicated.

structural_cues: 59:22 pairs knowledge of hidden and witnessed; 59:24 follows with creator, originator, form-giver, and the beautiful names.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies divine knowledge, measure, origination, form, and naming; I infer that these are epistemic conditions for creaturely self-recognition. A live alternative is that the closing names establish divine majesty after the warning rather than unpacking the causative فأنساهم.

changed_reading.before: Forgetting God causes a psychological failure of self-awareness.
changed_reading.after: The failure is also derivative and ontological: rejecting the self's knower, measure, maker, form-giver, and naming horizon removes the very coordinates by which that self can be recognized.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The valuation reversal is surprising because it combines distant branch images rather than translating the clause directly. It remains anchored in the focus's doubled ن س ي and أَنفُسَهُمْ: one branch makes the forgotten thing discarded baggage, while another makes the self something precious and competed for. Downstream prose should present this as a diagnostic image of devaluation, not claim that the verse lexically calls persons refuse.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The forgotten object is explicitly their selves, joining the discarded-object branch of ن س ي to the precious-object branch of ن ف س.

activation_trace.role: A forgotten, cast-off, negligible object supplies the degraded status into which the self is placed.
A precious thing desired and competed for supplies the self's opposite, proper valuation.
The thing devalued is not an external possession but the agents' own identity and reality.

changed_reading.before: They lose track of something important about themselves.
changed_reading.after: Their neglect reverses valuation itself: the precious reality that is their own self comes to be handled like baggage too negligible to remember.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The comparison is surprising because it crosses two different material roots and should not collapse تَصَدُّع into فِسْق. It remains anchored in the focus's rind-exit image and the nearby context's solid mountain cracking under reverent reception. Downstream prose should qualify it as a contrastive material analogy: responsive fracture may open a hardened form, while fasiq exit abandons its sustaining enclosure.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: الفاسقون carries the image of fruit leaving its rind, set near a mountain that becomes humble and split from divine fear.

activation_trace.role: Fruit leaving its rind supplies a break that abandons an enclosing support.
A high solid mass establishes the resistant material that nevertheless responds.
Lowering and submission make the mountain's alteration receptive rather than rebellious.
A fissure opening in something solid supplies the contrasting kind of break.
Fear joined to awe supplies the relation that makes fracture an act of response.

changed_reading.before: Breaking integrity is uniformly a sign of failure.
changed_reading.after: The context permits two materially different openings: the mountain breaks in receptive awe, while the forgetful self exits its rind; the warning may concern not whether one breaks, but whether divine address opens or evacuates the self.

strongest_changes: The doubled forgetting became a causal rebound: abandoned divine orientation returns as interior eviction and self-authored unhousing.
The adjacent self-accounting command made self-forgetting diachronic, severing today's actor from tomorrow's recipient.
The preference-over-self sequence made true self-preservation relational rather than possessive.
The closing knowledge, creation, form, and naming sequence made self-recognition dependent on the self's divine source.
summary.what_was_special: The focus's repeated ن س ي and concrete ف س ق rind-exit image allowed social, temporal, architectural, organic, and ontological contexts to change the mechanism without displacing the focus words.
remaining_uncertainties: The organic rootedness and two-breakages readings depend on controlled material analogy; the packet does not require those images to be explanatory symbols.
The social and creator-form sequences may function as strong contrasts or frames rather than direct explanations of the causative فَأَنسَاهُمْ.
The split between active neglect and involuntary loss is morphologically useful but cannot by itself settle how agency is distributed across the two ن س ي occurrences.
